verdict.rationale: A government tax and licensing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such assistant. The Business Licensing Wizard is a guided form, the 24/7 phone line is an automated system, and the Small Business Credit auto-calculation is a fixed rule; none of these lets a user delegate tasks to an AI. The authenticated My DOR portal could not be inspected, which lowers confidence somewhat.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
